response.overview: Congratulations on choosing the Ford Explorer! Please take a moment to view this guide for your new vehicle. It will help you with the Explorer's basic operation as well as important safety tips and general maintenance. Also, review the owner's manual for more complete details on your Explorer.  We are pleased that you have chosen our product and wish you many miles of enjoyable driving.
